### tool/vocabulary/corpus/b07/answers/one-handed-reach.txt ### Notes
state pulled=false
state q=""
state scale=100
state notes=[{"id":"n1","title":"Groceries for Sunday","body":"Oat milk, lemons, basil, fresh pasta","when":"Today","pinned":true},{"id":"n2","title":"Call the dentist","body":"Ask about the 9:30 slot on Thursday","when":"Today","pinned":false},{"id":"n3","title":"Trip ideas","body":"Lisbon in March, Kyoto in the autumn","when":"Yesterday","pinned":false},{"id":"n4","title":"Book list","body":"The Overstory, Piranesi, Braiding Sweetgrass","when":"Mon","pinned":false},{"id":"n5","title":"Standup notes","body":"Ship the onboarding fix, review Priya's PR","when":"Mon","pinned":false},{"id":"n6","title":"Gift for Mum","body":"Ceramic planter, the green one from the market","when":"Sun","pinned":false}]
App scale={scale/100} onEdgeSwipeRight={go reach} onEdgeSwipeLeft={go note}
  Main
    ListView pulldown={pulled} onPullDown={pulled=true} onPullUp={pulled=false} gap=8 pad=16
      Spacer h={pulled ? 320 : 0}
      each n in filter(notes, x=>contains(lower(x.title), lower(q)))
        Card gap=4 onTap={go note} animate=fade stagger=40
          Row between
            Text.strong "{n.title}"
            if n.pinned
              Icon "push_pin"
          Text.muted "{n.body}"
          Text.caption "{n.when}"
    Footer
      Row between pad=8
        IconButton "search" tooltip="Search" onTap={open searchSheet}
        IconButton "sort" tooltip="Sort" onTap={notes=sortBy(notes, x=>x.title)}
        Button "New note" icon="add" onTap={go note}
        IconButton "map" tooltip="Reach map" onTap={go reach}
        IconButton "tune" tooltip="Screen size" onTap={go scaling}
  Sheet#searchSheet
    Input "Search notes" @q
    Row gap=8
      Button.outline "Clear" onTap={q=""}
      Button "Done" onTap={close}
  Sheet#pulledTitle "Thumbzone" pulled
    Text.muted "{length(notes)} notes"
### tool/vocabulary/corpus/2026-11-16-sonnet/answers/meal-planner.txt ### Favourites
App fill=#FFFBF3
  Sidebar fill=#FFF3E2
    Brand "Mise" icon="skillet" font=serif color=#FF4F7A3A
    NavItem "Recipes" icon="menu_book" onTap={go recipes}
    NavItem "Week" icon="calendar_month" onTap={go week}
    NavItem "Shopping list" icon="shopping_basket" onTap={go shopping}
    NavItem "Favourites" icon="favorite" selected={true} badge="{length(favs)}" onTap={go favourites}
  Main
    Nav
      Heading "Favourites" level=1 font=serif color=#FF4F7A3A
    Column pad=24 gap=16 scroll
      if length(favs)==0
        Column center gap=8 pad=48
          Dish "empty-heart" h=120
          Heading "No favourites yet" level=3 font=serif
          Text.muted "Tap the heart on any recipe to keep it here."
          Button "Browse recipes" onTap={go recipes}
      Grid cols=4 gap=16
        each r in filter(recipes,x=>contains(favs,x.id))
          Card gap=8 radius=16 onTap={cur=r; serv=r.serv; have=[]; go recipe}
            Dish "{r.kind}" h=120
            Heading "{r.name}" level=3 font=serif
            Row between middle
              Text.small "{r.mins} min - {r.lvl}"
              IconButton "favorite" color=#FFD9482B onTap={favs=without(favs,r.id); toast "Removed"}
### tool/vocabulary/corpus/b09/answers/tractor-guidance.txt ### Implement
project night=false saved
project width=12
project overlap=0.1
state turn="Keep-left"
state headland=2
state lift=true
App theme={night ? "dark" : "light"}
  Main
    Nav
      Row gap=8 middle
        IconButton "arrow_back" tooltip="Back" onTap={go guidance}
        Heading "Implement and display" level=3
      Button "Done" onTap={emit saveSettings; go guidance}
    Column scroll pad=16 gap=16
      Card gap=12
        Text.strong "Working width"
        Row between middle
          Text "{width} m" size=40 weight=700
          Row gap=8
            IconButton "remove" tooltip="Narrower" onTap={width=max(1,round(width-0.5,1))}
            IconButton "add" tooltip="Wider" onTap={width=min(40,round(width+0.5,1))}
        Slider @width min=1 max=40
        Input "Exact width (m)" type=number @width
      Card gap=12
        Text.strong "Overlap"
        Row between
          Text "{round(overlap*100,0)}% of width"
          Text.muted "Pass spacing {fixed(width*(1-overlap),2)} m"
        Slider @overlap min=0 max=0.5
        PassPreview width={width} overlap={overlap} passes=3 h=120
      Card gap=12
        Text.strong "Headland and turns"
        Select "Turn pattern" items=["Keep-left","Skip one","Skip two","U-turn"] @turn
        Row between middle
          Text "Headland passes"
          Row gap=8 middle
            IconButton "remove" tooltip="Fewer" onTap={headland=max(0,headland-1)}
            Text.strong "{headland}"
            IconButton "add" tooltip="More" onTap={headland=min(6,headland+1)}
        Toggle "Warn before headland (150 m)" @lift
      Card gap=12
        Text.strong "Display"
        SegmentedButton items=["Day","Night"] selected={night ? "Night" : "Day"} onChange={night=(result=="Night")}
        Text.muted "Night mode dims the map and uses amber for the line bar."
